svg.text: Q4: radius 100 on a 10 cube edge: a near flat cut through both far edges
the pivot rule is defined for every r above half the chord; as r grows the arc tends to the chord
A. pivot through both far edges (CHOSEN)
builds; the arc is almost the chord through the
two far edges. Continuous in r.
B. decline above a cap (r > the diagonal)
IsDone false: a radius of 100 on a 10 mm cube
is more likely a typo than an intent.
a quarter circle ending on both far edges.
